name: Universitat de Barcelona
englishBachelors: English Studies has Catalan/Spanish exceptions; a complete English route needs confirmation
note: A large public university, mostly teaching in Catalan and Spanish at bachelor level.
admissionsUrlNote: Read in an ordinary browser on 2026-09-23 (Claude in Chrome, the owner's own browser session): the page loads normally there and sorts foreign-qualification applicants by whether they have begun university. Its "not begun" branch (www.ub.edu/acad/en/admission/start_studies.html, updated 17.03.2025) names "European Baccalaureate, International Baccalaureate or Secondary studies from EU educational systems" as its own route and refers the detail to the Generalitat of Catalonia. The host still refuses automated retrieval, so the link checker cannot confirm it.
summary: Public university across Barcelona's city campuses; English Studies teaches mainly in English, with Catalan/Spanish exceptions that need checking before you apply.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss (grade 5–10), then Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Only PAU specific-phase or UNED PCE exams lift it towards 14; IB subject grades on the credential do not count.

programmes.name: Bachelor's degree in English Studies
programmes.about: English language, applied linguistics and literature, with some common Philology subjects taught in Catalan or Spanish.
programmes.overview: The degree builds advanced English alongside literature from different periods and cultures and the study of applied linguistics. Classes cover English language, literature and linguistics, ending with a final degree project; external placements are optional. Graduates enter language teaching, research, public administration, publishing and cultural work. The current programme page names Catalan/Spanish exceptions for common basic-training subjects; ask UB whether a complete English route is possible.
programmes.selectionNote: The July 2026 PAU/FP cut-off was the minimum access grade (5.000): everyone eligible in that route got a place. 160 places; this is no guarantee for 2027.

notes: English Studies: the current programme page names Catalan/Spanish exceptions for common Philology basic-training subjects, while the older UB leaflet says 100% English. Ask UB whether the whole 2027 degree can be completed in English before applying.
Business Administration and Management and Biomedical Engineering teach part of their courses in English, but most of the degree is in Catalan and Spanish.
Bioinformatics is taught in English jointly by UB, UPC, UAB and UPF, and is listed under the Polytechnic University of Catalonia, which coordinates it.
